message.content: Evaluation of language models requires checking whether their in-context learning outputs behave as consistent probabilistic estimates. Real-world utility demands assessment through comprehensive, domain-specific benchmarks like those for visual impairment assistance. These approaches jointly test both the statistical validity and practical effectiveness of model predictions.
